Can I work in pizza hut , where i have to touch pork to make pizza. 2266 views Q. What is the Islamic veredict on lesbianism? 5086 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31945 Country: India Title: 1. Is it allowed for children to play with toys which have pictures or are in the shape of fairy tale characters(like dolls)? Question: 1. Is it allowed for children to play with toys which have pictures or are in the shape of fairy tale characters(like dolls)? 2. Is it allowed to watch cricket on TV? 3. Is reading the newspaper allowed? there are mostly photographs of politicians and other famous personalities in it. 4. Is it allowed to watch religious discourses on TV by male clerics? Answer ID: 31945 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 934/610/H=1432) (1) It is not lawful (2) It is unlawful. (3) It is allowable if one reads it while ignoring the unlawful pictures as much as possible. (4) What do you mean by “to watch religious discourses on TV by male clerics”? Write it clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
